questions.q: What is the real cube root of unity?
questions.e: Since 1 x 1 x 1 = 1, the only real cube root of unity is 1; the other two cube roots are complex. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: The inverse of a non-singular scalar matrix is which type of matrix?
questions.e: The inverse of the scalar matrix kI is (1/k)I, which is again a scalar matrix. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: What is sin(180 degrees - x) equal to?
questions.e: In the second quadrant sine is positive, so sin(180 degrees - x) = sin x. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: If the letters of UTYEAB are arranged in alphabetical order, which letter comes last?
questions.e: In alphabetical order the letters are A, B, E, T, U, Y, so the last one is Y. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: If yesterday was Friday, what day will it be the day after tomorrow?
questions.e: If yesterday was Friday, today is Saturday, tomorrow is Sunday and the day after tomorrow is Monday. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: How many months of the year have 31 days?
questions.e: January, March, May, July, August, October and December have 31 days. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: A book is bought for Rs 30 and sold for Rs 40. What is the profit percentage?
questions.e: Profit is Rs 10, so profit percentage = 10/30 x 100 = 33.33%. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: By what name is the empty set also known?
questions.e: A set with no elements is called the empty set or null set, written as {} or the symbol for phi. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: Which word is closest in meaning to 'prescribe'?
questions.e: To prescribe means to lay down or direct something as a rule or remedy, which is close to order. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: What is the approximate value of the cube root of -2?
questions.e: Since 1.26 cubed is about 2.0, the cube root of -2 is about -1.26. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: What is 90% of 90?
questions.e: 90% of 90 = 0.9 x 90 = 81. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: What is the value of sin 90 degrees?
questions.e: The sine of 90 degrees is 1, its maximum value. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: There are 48 heads of hens and cows together and 140 legs in total. How many hens are there?
questions.e: Let hens = h and cows = c; h + c = 48 and 2h + 4c = 140 give c = 22 and h = 26. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: Which function key is used to run the spell check in MS Word?
questions.e: Pressing F7 opens the spelling and grammar check in MS Word. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: What is the integral of cot x with respect to x?
questions.e: Since cot x = cos x / sin x, substitution u = sin x gives ln|sin x| + C. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: Which planet comes closest to the Earth?
questions.e: Venus comes nearer to Earth than any other planet at its closest approach. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: What is used to measure the magnitude of an earthquake?
questions.e: The Richter scale measures earthquake magnitude. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: In word processing, what is the term for the space between the page margin and the start of a paragraph's text?
questions.e: Indentation is the space between the margin and the beginning of a paragraph's lines. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: What is the term for trimming away the unwanted outer area of an image?
questions.e: Cropping removes the unneeded outer parts of an image, keeping only the area you want. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: Which Microsoft Word feature is used to create decorative, styled text effects?
questions.e: WordArt applies decorative styling such as shadows, outlines and curves to text. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: Which vitamin helps in healing wounds?
questions.e: Vitamin C is needed to make collagen, which is essential for wound healing. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: Which nutrient is the best source of quick energy for an athlete?
questions.e: Carbohydrates are broken down into glucose, the body's fastest source of energy. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: A person buys a book for Rs 500 and sells it for Rs 700. What is the percentage profit?
questions.e: Profit is 700 - 500 = 200, and 200/500 x 100 = 40%. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: Which pronoun can replace the noun 'school' in a sentence?
questions.e: 'School' is a singular non-living noun, so the pronoun 'it' replaces it. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: How many articles are there in English grammar?
questions.e: The articles are 'a', 'an' (indefinite) and 'the' (definite). Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: What is one tenth of 90?
questions.e: One tenth of 90 is 90 divided by 10, which is 9. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: What is one tenth of 120?
questions.e: One tenth of 120 is 120 divided by 10, which is 12. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: In English grammar, an article is mostly placed before which part of speech?
questions.e: Articles (a, an, the) come before a noun or the adjective describing it. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: In a class of 1500 students, 1200 are present. What is the percentage of present students?
questions.e: 1200/1500 x 100 = 80%. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: In a class of 500 students, 340 are present. What is the percentage of absent students?
questions.e: Absent students are 500 - 340 = 160, and 160/500 x 100 = 32%. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 3 times.

questions.q: A train travels at 120 miles per hour. How far will it travel in 12 minutes?
questions.e: 12 minutes is 0.2 hour, and 120 x 0.2 = 24 miles. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 2 times.

questions.q: If yesterday was Monday, what will be the day after tomorrow?
questions.e: Today is Tuesday, tomorrow is Wednesday, so the day after tomorrow is Thursday. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 2 times.

questions.q: In a class of 500 students, 360 are boys. What percentage are girls?
questions.e: Girls are 500 - 360 = 140, and 140/500 x 100 = 28%. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 2 times.

questions.q: A helicopter needs 50 gallons of fuel to travel 320 km. How many gallons will it need for 400 km?
questions.e: Fuel per km is 50/320, so 400 km needs 400 x 50/320 = 62.5 gallons. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 2 times.

questions.q: Amjad and Ahmed together have 24 balloons. Amjad has three times as many as Ahmed. How many balloons does Amjad have?
questions.e: Ahmed has x and Amjad 3x, so 4x = 24, x = 6 and Amjad has 18. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 2 times.

questions.q: A train travels at 120 km per hour. How far will it travel in 18 minutes?
questions.e: 18 minutes is 0.3 hour, and 120 x 0.3 = 36 km. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 2 times.

questions.q: If nP2 = 20, what is the value of n?
questions.e: nP2 = n(n-1) = 20, which gives n = 5. Past repeated PMA LC question, listed 2 times.

questions.q: Which vitamin does the human body make with the help of sunlight?
questions.e: Skin exposed to sunlight produces Vitamin D. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: Who is the author of the play "Hamlet"?
questions.e: Hamlet is a tragedy written by William Shakespeare around 1600. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: What is the standard lactation period of a buffalo, in days?
questions.e: The standard lactation period used for dairy animals is 305 days. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: Rickets disease is caused by a deficiency of which vitamin?
questions.e: Lack of Vitamin D leads to weak bones in children, called rickets. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: What is the multiplicative identity of the complex numbers?
questions.e: Multiplying any complex number by 1 leaves it unchanged, so 1 is the multiplicative identity. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: Which acid is responsible for the pain of an ant bite?
questions.e: Ants inject formic acid, which causes the burning pain. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: From which source do plants mainly obtain nitrogen (as nitrates)?
questions.e: Plants absorb nitrogen through their roots from the soil, mostly as nitrates formed by nitrogen-fixing and nitrifying bacteria. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: Which type of cell lacks a true nucleus?
questions.e: Prokaryotic cells, such as bacteria, have no membrane-bound nucleus; their DNA lies free in the cytoplasm. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: Which instrument is used to measure the altitude of the sun above the horizon?
questions.e: A sextant measures the angle between a celestial body such as the sun and the horizon. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: If the eccentricity e is greater than 1, the conic section is a?
questions.e: A conic has e > 1 for a hyperbola, e = 1 for a parabola and e < 1 for an ellipse. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: The mantissa of a logarithm is always?
questions.e: A logarithm is written as characteristic plus mantissa, and the mantissa is always a non-negative decimal fraction less than 1. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: What is a line that touches a circle at exactly one point called?
questions.e: A tangent touches the circle at one point, while a secant cuts it at two points. Past PMA LC question.
